item.title: DistroKid, repped by Goldman Sachs and Raine, exploring a sale
item.description: New York-based company claims that it handles 30% to 40% of new music releases globally Source

item.title: Andy Serrao named Chief Creative Officer at Concord Label Group
item.description: He will oversee A&R and strategic marketing across the company’s owned label imprints, including Fearless Records, Concord Records, and Rounder Records. Source

item.title: Fred Armisen to host CNN music docuseries pulling from UMG’s underground vault
item.description: The vault lies within the Iron Mountain facility in Boyers, Pennsylvania, where UMG stores a portion of its catalog 220 feet underground. Source

item.title: Spotify to open Istanbul office, names Akshat Harbola as Managing Director for MENA and Türkiye
item.description: Harbola says that Türkiye as a “priority market” for the streaming giant. Source

item.title: Apple acquires AI audio startup Q.ai said to be worth nearly $2bn
item.description: The startup’s 100 employees will join Apple, including CEO Aviad Maizels and co-founders Yonatan Wexler and Avi Barliya. Source

item.title: Suno hires former Spotify exec Sam Berger as Senior Director of Artist Partnerships
item.description: Berger joins a team that includes industry professionals who previously worked at Snap, 88rising, Twitch, Splice, Atlantic Records, Motown Records, Capitol Records and Sony Music. Source

item.title: UMG bought a stake in superfan app Stationhead – here are 3 things you might have missed…
item.description: Superfan monetization and D2C expansion continue to be strategic priorities for Universal Music Group. Source

item.title: WMG’s Paul Robinson honored with Recording Academy’s ELI Service Award: He ‘stands for everything that is honest, diligent, fair.’
item.description: Robinson has served as WMG's top lawyer since 2006 Source

item.title: K-pop giant JYP’s China unit and CJ ENM strike joint venture with Tencent Music
